integrity: The exhaustive program enumerates every ordered binary automaton for two through five states, every nontrivial state partition, and exact subset-automaton reachability. Every accepted five-state case is additionally checked by generated-congruence closure and pair compressibility, and the complete symmetry quotient is recomputed.
scientific_limitations: The classification is finite, binary, and excludes the purely permutation case. It does not classify larger alphabets or more than five states. Unpublished enumeration output associated with earlier experiments could contain the same filtered census.
title: The smallest binary primitive nonsynchronizing nonpermutation boundary
